title: Semana De Bienestar
description: Semana De Bienestar (Wellness Week) is a free, bilingual, alcohol-free community event at Wilkinson Public Library offering programming for children, adults, and families. Activities are available in both English and Spanish, making this an inclusive celebration of wellbeing for the broader Telluride community.

title: The Creative Exchange at Telluride Arts HQ
description: The Creative Exchange is a brand-new monthly series by Telluride Arts designed for the artists and creatives who call Telluride home. It’s a space where emerging and established artists gather to share the knowledge, skills, and stories that fuel their work. Think of it as an open source model for creativity—where we learn from each other, swap ideas, and help strengthen one another’s practice. Each session is hosted by local artists and creative leaders who bring their own perspectives, techniques, and creative journeys into the room. Topics may span everything from the business of art and professional development, to creative process, storytelling, collaboration, and the philosophical underpinnings of making art. Whether you’re a full-time working artist, an educator, a student, a maker, or simply someone curious about creative expression, the Creative Exchange is open to you. …

title: Facing the Mourning
description: Facing the Mourning is a free, four-week grief support series taking place every Thursday throughout September. When: Thursdays in September at 6:00 PM Where: Redvale Community Center Cost: Free The series is open to anyone who may benefit from additional support while navigating grief and loss. Please feel free to share this information with others who may be interested.

title: Ridgway Independent Film Festival
description: The Ridgway Independent Film Festival returns to the historic Sherbino Theater in downtown Ridgway for a weekend running November 13–15, 2026. The festival features independent short films, select longer works, and filmmaker Q&As, bringing together filmmakers and audiences for a weekend of storytelling and community connection.

title: KOTO Ski Swap
description: This year’s ski swap takes place Friday, November 13th, thru Monday, November 16th in the garage of the Wilkinson Public Library. Details of each day shared below. Friday 11/13 Individual Seller Check-in/Gear Drop off — 11 AM – 6 PM $1 per tag/item will be charged at check-in — cash or Venmo please Saturday 11/14 Pre-Swap for Volunteers Only — 8:30 AM – 10 AM Ski Swap Sale — 10 AM – 4 PM *DISCOUNT HOUR 3-4 PM* Sunday 11/15 Individual Seller Payout/Gear Pickup — 10 AM – 3 PM IMPORTANT: Any unsold items NOT picked up on Sunday will be considered a donation to KOTO, no exceptions . title: Ridgway Independent Film Fest 2026
description: 12 Years of Fierce, Fearless, Independent Film The Ridgway Independent Film Festival (RIFF) returns in 2026 with its 12th year of celebrating bold storytelling, emerging filmmakers, and the power of community through the lens of independent film. The RIFF committee has selected films with a lineup of 6 blocks of films spanning 3 days. View Digital Program, tickets and more. Individual Block Tickets: $15 All Access Festival Pass: $75 Rooted in a volunteer-driven, grassroots effort born shortly after Ridgway became one of Colorado’s first Certified Creative Districts, RIFF continues to evolve while honoring its origins. This year, RIFF returns to its longtime home in November, taking place November 13–15, 2026, with a refreshed structure designed to create deeper connection and conversation. …

title: 2026 Western Colorado Farm & Ranch Innovation Expo — Free Admission
description: Discover agricultural innovation, explore practical ideas, and connect with your Western Slope neighbors at the free 2026 Western Colorado Farm & Ranch Innovation Expo, November 13–14 at the Montrose County Event Center. Hosted by the Western Colorado Soil Health Committee, this welcoming gathering brings together farmers, ranchers, gardeners, water leaders, educators, students, businesses, and community members for demonstrations, exhibits, presentations, and conversations. FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13 Expo hours: noon–7 p.m. Explore agricultural equipment, technology, and exhibits, with water-related demonstrations beginning at 2 p.m. following the West Slope Water Summit. Meet vendors and producers, ask questions, and discover practical irrigation and water-management approaches. Also on Friday: West Slope Water Summit, 7:30 a.m.–2 p.m. This free gathering explores Western Colorado’s water outlook, watershed health, and agriculture’s connection to water, and includes an FFA student research presentation. Separate advance registration is required, with complimentary breakfast and lunch for registered participants. …

title: Rainbow, Rockies and Rascals 2026 Fall Fundraiser!
description: Rainbow, Rockies and Rascals will host a silent/live auction fundraiser on Friday, November 13th at the Telluride Science and Innovation Center from 5:30pm-9:30pm. Tickets are $15 from any program parent or $20 at the door and enters you into a 2026/2027 Ski Pass raffle. Come and enjoy free champagne (while it lasts), delicious hors d'oeuvres from Black Salt Hospitality, music by DJ Sam, live auction MC'ed by Zoe Dohnal and an amazing silent auction with merchandise and services donated by our generous local businesses.

title: Stories & Poems Telluride
description: Storyteller and writer Craig Childs will join his wife poet Daiva Česonis, both of them living at the edge of Naturita Canyon on Wrights Mesa near Norwood, for an evening of storytelling and poetry at the Wilkinson Public Library’s magazine room Tuesday Nov. 17 th at 5:15 pm MST.

title: Roots to Routes: A Community Storytelling Night
description: Some of the best adventures start right outside our front door, and others take us halfway around the world. Join the Telluride Mountain Club for Roots to Routes, a new storytelling night where your neighbors share personal, authentic outdoor adventures, from big expeditions abroad to memorable weekends close to home. Each storyteller gets 10 minutes to present with slides, followed by 3 minutes for Q&A. Have a story to share? We’re looking for a real mix of adventures, including climbing, mountaineering, rafting, skiing, bikepacking, hiking, and more, from people of all ages and experience levels. Submit your story by November 3rd. We look forward to seeing you there!

title: The Classics Taproom Society
description: Discover the magic of classic literature in our newest book club, where we celebrate the milestones of timeless works! With the upcoming 50th, 75th, and 100th anniversaries of these literary treasures in 2026 and 2027, there’s no better time to dive deep into great stories. Each month features a passionate guest moderator who will guide you through rich discussions. The library will provide light appetizers and Telluride Brewing Company will also be offering $5 TBC beers during the book club. Join us at Telluride Brewing Company in Lawson Hill on the 3rd Wednesday of the month Oct-March at 5:30pm to discuss the following classics: November 18- Foundation (75 years) by Isaac Asimov – presented by Laura Colbert December 16- The Catcher in the Rye by J.D. …
location: Telluride Brewing Company Lawson Hill Taproom

title: The Sherbino & Citizens State Bank Present: Winter Wildlands Alliance BACKCOUNTRY FILM FEST
description: The Sherbino and CSB Present: Winter Wildlands Alliance Backcountry Film Festival Doors: 6:00pm || Films: 6:30pm || $10 students and seniors (18-/ 65+) || $15 General Admission The Backcountry Film Festival, presented by Winter Wildlands Alliance, celebrates the power and spirit of humans in winter. Since its inception, the festival has toured across states, countries—even Antarctica—screening hundreds of inspiring films that celebrate adventure, conservation, and the magic of winter. Over the years, the festival has raised millions of dollars to support local projects that strengthen winter communities and protect our wild snowscapes. The 2026-27 winter season is the 22nd Anniversary of the Backcountry Film Festival! This year showcases a dynamic lineup of short documentaries and ski films that transport audiences straight to the heart of winter. …

title: Salon Night at Telluride Arts HQ
description: Salon Nights are inspired by the legendary Parisian salons—those lively gatherings where artists, thinkers, and dreamers came together to meet up, debate, collaborate, and inspire. We’re bringing that spirit into the present and rooting it here in Telluride. These are evenings for conversation and connection, not lectures or formal programming. They are casual, open, and intentionally unstructured, designed to create the atmosphere where ideas can collide, new friendships form, and creativity sparks. Imagine an evening where musicians talk with writers, painters meet photographers, filmmakers share stories with ceramicists—and the unexpected happens!

title: Ladies Night In at the Library
description: Join us at the library for an evening of pampering, snacks, and great company. We’ll be screening a surprise classic chick flick while enjoying fresh popcorn, chocolate, hot tea, face masks, eye patches, and unique nail polishes. You'll also have the chance to win prizes from local businesses including Studio G, Aveda Telluride Spa, and Two Skirts. Cozy attire and blankets are encouraged. This event is for adults only. Advance registration is encouraged so we know how many self-care supplies to provide :) Gather your girlfriends or come solo for our very first Ladies Night In!

title: Around The World: America’s Pumpkin Beer & Chocolate Pretzels
description: Owner and Brewmaster, TJ is taking us on a journey to early America to discover how a humble native gourd became our continent’s most iconic seasonal tradition. Long before pumpkin spice became a modern phenomenon, early American colonists relied on native pumpkins to survive winter and celebrate the harvest holidays. Join us for a curated tasting event exploring the rich history of American pumpkin brewing paired with traditional European-style chocolate pretzels. Grab your tasting passport, explore the global trade routes that brought us holiday spices, and toast to the historic flavors of the American harvest season! (Ages 21+ only).

title: Dance Fit Fusion
description: Join Marlen for a high-energy dance fitness class fused with barre, pilates and stretching that mixes low-intensity and high-intensity moves for an interval-style, calorie-burning workout that will tone your body and boost your endurance without even realizing how hard you are working. It is exercise in disguise! No dance experience is required—just bring your energy, a water bottle, and a smile. This class is free and open to the public, but donations for the instructor are always welcome. Únete a Marlen para una clase de fitness de baile llena de energía combinada con barre, pilates y estiramientos que combina movimientos de baja y alta intensidad para un entrenamiento de intervalos que quema calorías, tonificando tu cuerpo y aumentando tu resistencia sin darte cuenta de lo duro que estás trabajando. ¡Es ejercicio disfrazado! No se requiere experiencia en baile—solo lleva tu energía, una botella de agua y una sonrisa. …

description: Join us for this 4 part series as we watch episodes from RMPBS Flagship history series, explores the people, places. and events that has shaped Colorado's rich heritage. August: "The Original Coloradans" An incredible look at the Ute Nation, their history before colonization, and their interactions with early trappers. September: " October: November: "The Games That Never Happened". The fascinating modern-history story of how Denver became the only city in the world to win the Winter Olympics and then vote to give them back!

title: Trivia Night at The Stronghouse Brew Pub
description: Gather together your smartest friends and come on down to the Stronghouse Brew Pub for a thrilling night of Library Trivia! Top three teams will get a gift card to the Stronghouse ($75, $50, $25) and we'll do additional raffles for people who have a library card and/or a Friends of the Library membership.
